page.overview:
Who is Disguised banana guard?

The Disguised Banana Guard is a Banana Guard in a horse costume who was going to be used as a trap in order to capture Princess Cookie. The costume has the "poo brain" appearance, similar to the horse costume Ice King used in the episode "The Eyes." The costume is too small and part of the Banana Guard shows in the middle; the Banana Guard is even still holding his spear.
